 REAL RR3 = R3

! cable numbers for multi-cables
INTEGER CABNUM2 = CABNUM + 1
INTEGER CABNUM3 = CABNUM + 2
! Distance between cables
REAL D1 = ~
#IF (NC ==3)
~(2.0 + 1.0e-6)*~
#CASE LL {~R2} {~RR3} {~RR4} {~RR5} {~RR6} {~RR7}
#ELSEIF (NC==0)
~0.0
#ELSE
~D
#ENDIF
! XY Coordinates for three cables (X,Y1)(X2,Y2)(X3,Y3)
#IF (NC==1)||(NC==4)
 REAL X2 = X + D1
 REAL Y2 = Y
#ENDIF
#IF (NC==1)
 REAL X3 = X + 2.0*D1
 REAL Y3 = Y
#ENDIF
#IF (NC==2)||(NC==3)
 REAL Y1  = Y -0.577350269189626*D1
 REAL X2  = X -0.5*D1
 REAL Y2  = Y + 0.288675134594813*D1
 REAL X3  = X + 0.5*D1
 REAL Y3  = Y + 0.288675134594813*D1
#ELSE
 REAL Y1 = Y
#ENDIF
! Resistivities of condctor materials (see IEC 60287-1-1)
REAL P_CU     = 1.724E-8
REAL P_AL     = 2.826E-8
REAL P_STEEL  = 13.8E-8
REAL P_LEAD   = 21.4E-8
REAL P_BRONZE = 3.5E-8
! Relative permittivities of insulating materials (see IEC 60287-1-1)
REAL ER_XLPE = 2.5
REAL ER_PVC  = 8.0
REAL ER_EPR  = 3.0
REAL ER_IP   = 3.6
REAL ER_PE   = 2.3
!
REAL CONST= 17.97510357477
! Resistivity
REAL RRHOC = ~
#CASE DTC {~DCRC*PI*(R2*R2-R1*R1)/1000.0} {~RHOC} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE}  
REAL RRHOS = ~
#CASE DTS {~DCRS*PI*(RR4*RR4-RR3*RR3)/1000.0} {~RHOS} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE} 
REAL RRHOA = ~
#CASE DTA {~DCRA*PI*(RR6*RR6-RR5*RR5)/1000.0} {~RHOA} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE}  
! insulator relative permitivity
REAL EEPS1 = ~
#CASE DTI1 {~CONST*CI1*LOG(RR3/R2)} {~EPS1} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
REAL EEPS2 = ~
#CASE DTI2 {~CONST*CI2*LOG(RR5/RR4)} {~EPS2} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
REAL EEPS3 = ~
#CASE DTI3 {~CONST*CI3*LOG(RR7/RR6)} {~EPS3} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
! Temperature correction R(t) = R(t0) *(1 + alpha*(t-t0))
#IF (TD==1)
 RRHOC = RRHOC*(1 + ALC*(OPC-TE1))
# IF LL>=2
 RRHOS = RRHOS*(1 + ALS*(OPS-TE1))
# ENDIF 
# IF LL>=4
 RRHOA = RRHOA*(1 + ALA*(OPA-TE1))
# ENDIF 
#ENDIF

#IF OHC==1
 REAL Y30 = Y10
#ELSE
 REAL Y30 = Y
#ENDIF
! Angle of each cable with respect to verical axis (clockwise) in deg
REAL ang1 = ANG10
REAL ang2 = ANG10 + 240.0
REAL ang3 = ANG10 + 120.0

#IF RorT==0
#IF SemiCL==1
  REAL RR3 = R3 + SL2
#ELSE
 REAL RR3 = R3
#ENDIF
 REAL RR4 = R4
 REAL RR5 = R5
 REAL RR6 = R6
 REAL RR7 = R7
#ELSEIF RorT==1 
#IF SemiCL==1
 REAL RR3 = R2 + T3 + SL1 + SL2
#ELSE
 REAL RR3 = R2 + T3
#ENDIF
 REAL RR4 = RR3 + T4
 REAL RR5 = RR4 + T5
 REAL RR6 = RR5 + T6
 REAL RR7 = RR6 + T7
#ENDIF

! Outer radisu of cable
REAL ROUT1 = ~
~(1.0 + 1.0e-6)*~
#CASE LL {~R2} {~RR3} {~RR4} {~RR5} {~RR6} {~RR7}

! Distance between pipe center and cable center
#IF NC==1
 REAL dccx = dcc
#ELSE
 REAL dccx = 1.154700538379252*ROUT1
#ENDIF

! XY Coordinates for three cables (X,Y1)(X2,Y2)(X3,Y3)
REAL X1 = dccx*sin(ang1*pi/180.0)
REAL Y1 = dccx*cos(ang1*pi/180.0)
REAL X2 = dccx*sin(ang2*pi/180.0)
REAL Y2 = dccx*cos(ang2*pi/180.0)
REAL X3 = dccx*sin(ang3*pi/180.0)
REAL Y3 = dccx*cos(ang3*pi/180.0)

! XY Coordinates for three cables (X,Y1)(X2,Y2)(X3,Y3)
! Resistivities of condctor materials (see IEC 60287-1-1)
REAL P_CU     = 1.724E-8
REAL P_AL     = 2.826E-8
REAL P_STEEL  = 13.8E-8
REAL P_LEAD   = 21.4E-8
REAL P_BRONZE = 3.5E-8

! Relative permittivities of insulating materials (see IEC 60287-1-1)
REAL ER_XLPE = 2.5
REAL ER_PVC  = 8.0
REAL ER_EPR  = 3.0
REAL ER_IP   = 3.6
REAL ER_PE   = 2.3
!
REAL CONST= 17.97510357477
! Resistivity
REAL RRHOC = ~
#CASE DTC {~DCRC*PI*(R2*R2-R1*R1)/1000.0} {~RHOC} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE}  
REAL RRHOS = ~
#CASE DTS {~DCRS*PI*(RR4*RR4-RR3*RR3)/1000.0} {~RHOS} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE} 
REAL RRHOA = ~
#CASE DTA {~DCRA*PI*(RR6*RR6-RR5*RR5)/1000.0} {~RHOA} {~P_CU} {~P_AL} {~P_STEEL} {~P_LEAD} {~P_BRONZE}  
! insulator relative permitivity
REAL EEPS1 = ~
#CASE DTI1 {~CONST*CI1*LOG(RR3/R2)} {~EPS1} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
REAL EEPS2 = ~
#CASE DTI2 {~CONST*CI2*LOG(RR5/RR4)} {~EPS2} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
REAL EEPS3 = ~
#CASE DTI3 {~CONST*CI3*LOG(RR7/RR6)} {~EPS3} {~ER_XLPE} {~ER_PVC} {~ER_EPR} {~ER_IP} {~ER_PE}
! Temperature correction R(t) = R(t0) *(1 + alpha*(t-t0))
#IF (TD==1)
 RRHOC = RRHOC*(1 + ALC*(OPC-TE1))
# IF LL>=2
 RRHOS = RRHOS*(1 + ALS*(OPS-TE1))
# ENDIF 
# IF LL>=4
 RRHOA = RRHOA*(1 + ALA*(OPA-TE1))
# ENDIF 
#ENDIF

        $O(IVD1_1) = NINT(RVD2_1(1))

 #ELSE

#BEGIN
  #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1 !IVD1_1 (in #BEGIN) is branch index (BR_IDX)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1 !RVD1_1 (in #BEGIN) is single-phase transformer MVA (Tmva1P_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2 !RVD1_2 (in #BEGIN) is L-N winding 1 voltage (V1_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_3 !RVD1_3 (in #BEGIN) is L-N winding 2 voltage (V2_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_4 !RVD1_4 (in #BEGIN) is the lower tap voltage (LowTapV_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_5 !RVD1_5 (in #BEGIN) is the upper tap voltage (UpTapV_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_6 !RVD1_6 (in #BEGIN) is the low tap leakage reactance (LowTapXL_)
  #LOCAL REAL RVD1_7 !RVD1_7 (in #BEGIN) is the upper tap leakage reactance (UpTapXL_) 
  #IF CoreType==4
    #LOCAL REAL RVD1_8 !RVD1_8 (in #BEGIN) is the ratio of zero sequence over positive !sequence leakage reactance at the low tap (LowTapRz0_)  
    #LOCAL REAL RVD1_9 !RVD1_9 (in #BEGIN) is the ratio of zero sequence over positive !sequence leakage reactance at the upper tap (UpTapRz0_)  
  #ENDIF
  #IF MagModel==4
    #LOCAL REAL RVD9_1 9 !RVD9_1 (in #BEGIN) is the saturation characteristic current points (I1E_ to I9E_)
    #LOCAL REAL RVD9_2 9 !RVD9_2 (in #BEGIN) is the saturation characteristic voltage points (V1E_ to V9E_)
  #ELSEIF (MagModel==5) || (MagModel==6)
    #LOCAL REAL RVD9_3 9 !RVD9_3 (in #BEGIN) is the saturation characteristic H points (H1_ to H9_)
    #LOCAL REAL RVD9_4 9 !RVD9_4 (in #BEGIN) is the saturation characteristic B points (B1_ to B9_)
  #ENDIF
!
!Computing the single-phase MVA
      RVD1_1 = $Tmva*ONE_3RD
!Computing the L-N voltages based on the
!winding configuration (Open, Y, or Delta)
  #IF OT==1
      RVD1_2=$V1
      RVD1_3=$V2
  #ELSEIF OT==0
    #IF W1==0
      RVD1_2=$V1LL*SQRT_1BY3
    #ELSEIF W1==1
      RVD1_2=$V1LL
    #ENDIF
    #IF W2==0
      RVD1_3=$V2LL*SQRT_1BY3
    #ELSEIF W2==1
      RVD1_3=$V2LL
    #ENDIF      
  #ENDIF   
!Setting the leakage reactance independent
!of the tap value if selected by the user
  #IF TapXL_Enab==0
      RVD1_4=0.01
      RVD1_5=100.0
      RVD1_6=$Xl_
      RVD1_7=$Xl_
    #IF CoreType==4
      RVD1_8=$Rz0_
      RVD1_9=$Rz0_
    #ENDIF
  #ELSEIF TapXL_Enab==1
      RVD1_4=$LowTapV_
      RVD1_5=$UpTapV_
      RVD1_6=$LowTapXL_
      RVD1_7=$UpTapXL_
    #IF CoreType==4

scripts.Computations:
!
!Code revision is used for calling relevant subroutines
!with different code revisions. CodeRev=1 is developed
!in 2019 by Mohammad Shafieipour and Rohitha Jayasinghe.
INTEGER CodeRev = 1
!
!Ungrounded Y resistance to ground (NeutralR) is used 
!to ensure numerical stability.
REAL NeutralR = 1.0E6
!
!Delta resistance to ground (DeltaR) is used to ensure 
!numerical stability.
REAL DeltaR = 1.0E6
!
!RC Branch Parameters (RC_Enab_, RbyZB_, Iexp_) are used
!to define an RC snubber placed in parallel with nonlinear
!magnetizing branches (i.e. MagModel/=0). They ensure 
!numerical stability in the duality-based models. 
!RbyZB_ and RCbyDT_ should be chosen to preserve numerical  
!accuracy while providing numerical robustness.
!Enable (RC_Enab_=1) or Disable (RC_Enab_==) RC filter.
INTEGER RC_Enab_=1
!RbyZB_ is the snubber's resistance divided by its base impedance.   
!In case of numerical instability, try smaller values of RbyZB_.
#IF CoreType==1 || CoreType==2 || CoreType==3
  REAL RbyZB_ = 20.0
#ELSEIF CoreType==4
  REAL RbyZB_ = 10.0
#ENDIF
!RCbyDT_ is the snubber's RC product divided by the time step   
!(DELT). With RCbyDT_=10.0 the number of required harmonics are 
!found to have been not affected. Do not modify RCbyDT_ for 
!achieving numerical stability unless you know what you are doing.
REAL RCbyDT_ = 10.0
!Expected Excitation Current. This is used to compute base
!impedance for RC snubber when Iexc is not available (i.e. 
!MagModel==3 || MagModel==6)
REAL Iexp_ = 0.1

scripts.Computations:
!
!Code revision is used for calling relevant subroutines
!with different code revisions. CodeRev=1 is developed
!in 2023 by Ajinkya Sinkar and Rohitha Jayasinghe.
!Based on the codes by Mohammad Shafieipour.
INTEGER CodeRev = 1
!
!Ungrounded Y resistance to ground (NeutralR) is used 
!to ensure numerical stability.
REAL NeutralR = 1.0E6
!
!Delta resistance to ground (DeltaR) is used to ensure 
!numerical stability.
REAL DeltaR = 1.0E6
!
!RC Branch Parameters (RC_Enab_, RbyZB_, Iexp_) are used
!to define an RC snubber placed in parallel with nonlinear
!magnetizing branches (i.e. MagModel/=0). They ensure 
!numerical stability in the duality-based models. 
!RbyZB_ and RCbyDT_ should be chosen to preserve numerical  
!accuracy while providing numerical robustness.
!Enable (RC_Enab_=1) or Disable (RC_Enab_==) RC filter.
INTEGER RC_Enab_ = 1
!RbyZB_ is the snubber's resistance divided by its base impedance.   
!In case of numerical instability, try smaller values of RbyZB_.
#IF CoreType==1 || CoreType==2 || CoreType==3
  REAL RbyZB_ = 20.0
#ELSEIF CoreType==4
  REAL RbyZB_ = 10.0
#ENDIF
!RCbyDT_ is the snubber's RC product divided by the time step   
!(DELT). With RCbyDT_=10.0 the number of required harmonics are 
!found to have been not affected. Do not modify RCbyDT_ for 
!achieving numerical stability unless you know what you are doing.
REAL RCbyDT_ = 10.0
!Expected Excitation Current. This is used to compute base
!impedance for RC snubber when Iexc is not available (i.e. 
!MagModel==3 || MagModel==6)
REAL Iexp_ = 0.1

!
!Code revision is used for calling relevant subroutines
!with different code revisions. CodeRev=1 is developed
!in 2023 by Ajinkya Sinkar and Rohitha Jayasinghe.
!Based on the codes by Mohammad Shafieipour.
INTEGER CodeRev = 1
!
!Ungrounded Y resistance to ground (NeutralR) is used 
!to ensure numerical stability.
REAL NeutralR = 1.0E6
!
!Delta resistance to ground (DeltaR) is used to ensure 
!numerical stability.
REAL DeltaR = 1.0E6
!
!RC Branch Parameters (RC_Enab_, RbyZB_, Iexp_) are used
!to define an RC snubber placed in parallel with nonlinear
!magnetizing branches (i.e. MagModel/=0). They ensure 
!numerical stability in the duality-based models. 
!RbyZB_ and RCbyDT_ should be chosen to preserve numerical  
!accuracy while providing numerical robustness.
!Enable (RC_Enab_=1) or Disable (RC_Enab_==) RC filter.
INTEGER RC_Enab_ = 1
!RbyZB_ is the snubber's resistance divided by its base impedance.   
!In case of numerical instability, try smaller values of RbyZB_.
REAL RbyZB_ = 20.0
!RCbyDT_ is the snubber's RC product divided by the time step   
!(DELT). With RCbyDT_=10.0 the number of required harmonics are 
!found to have been not affected. Do not modify RCbyDT_ for 
!achieving numerical stability unless you know what you are doing.
REAL RCbyDT_ = 10.0
!Expected Excitation Current. This is used to compute base
!impedance for RC snubber when Iexc is not available (i.e. 
!MagModel==3 || MagModel==6)
REAL Iexp_ = 0.1

            END WHERE

 #SUBROUTINE FTRAC3 FFT Frequency Tracking
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2

 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_3
      IF (TIMEZERO) THEN
        STOR(NEXC+$NXC) = $F
      ENDIF

 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}

      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN22,IVD1_1,$M22,$P22,$DC22)
#ELSEIF Type == 3
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN31,IVD1_1,$M31,$P31,$DC31)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN32,IVD1_1,$M32,$P32,$DC32)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN33,IVD1_1,$M33,$P33,$DC33)
#ELSEIF Type == 4
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$INA,IVD1_1,$MA,$PA,$DCA)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$INB,IVD1_1,$MB,$PB,$DCB)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$INC,IVD1_1,$MC,$PC,$DCC)
      CALL FTSEQN($harms,$PMod1,$MA,$MB,$MC,$PA,$PB,$PC)
#ELSEIF Type == 5
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(1),IVD1_1,$M31,$P31,$DC31)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(2),IVD1_1,$M32,$P32,$DC32)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,$PMod1,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(3),IVD1_1,$M33,$P33,$DC33)
#ELSEIF Type == 6
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(1),IVD1_1,$MA,$PA,$DCA)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(2),IVD1_1,$MB,$PB,$DCB)
      CALL FTN180($AMod,0,$harms,$Filt,$F,~
 #CASE Track {~$F} {~RVD1_1}
     +,$IN3(3),IVD1_1,$MC,$PC,$DCC)
      CALL FTSEQN($harms,$PMod1,$MA,$MB,$MC,$PA,$PB,$PC)
#ENDIF
#IF Track == 1

      IF (~

      IVD1_2 = NSTORI

 #CASE Type {~} {~$P11(1)} {~$P21(1)} {~$P31(1)} {~$PA(1)} {~$P31(1)} {~$PA(1)}

!
!  Single Phase Voltage Level Controller for 3level STATCOM
!  -generates firing pulses for a given set of voltage levels
!  (Vdc+/0/Vdc-)
!  $Q1 Firing pulse to GTO1positive
!  $Q2 Firing pulse to GTO2positive
!  $Q1C,$Q2C Firing pulses to GTO1negative and GTO2negative
!  $VORDER ( >0 = +Vdc , <0 = -Vdc , 0 )
!
      $Q1 = 0
      $Q2 = 0
      $Q1C = 0
      $Q2C = 0
      IF ( NINT($BLK) .NE. 0 ) THEN
         IF ($VORDER .GT. 0) $Q1 = 1
         IF ($VORDER .GE. 0) $Q2 = 1
         IF ($VORDER .LE. 0) $Q1C = 1
         IF ($VORDER .LT. 0) $Q2C = 1
      ENDIF
!

      ! Diode4

      CALL PESWITCH1_CFG(3, 0, RVD1_1, 10e6, 1.0e6, 1.0e6, 0.0, 0.0)

      ! IGBT1
      CALL PESWITCH1_CFG(3, 0, RVD1_1, 10e6, 1.0e8, 1.0e8, 0.0, 0.0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BRx1, 0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BRx2, 0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BRx3, 0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BRx4, 0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BR_Rv1, 0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_CFG(0 ,$SS , $BR_Rv2, 0)
 #ENDIF
#ENDBEGIN
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_3
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_4
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_5
#LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1
      CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component)
#IF DTBP==0
      RVD1_2  = CBR($BRx,$SS)
      RVD1_3  = VDC($a,$SS)-VDC($b,$SS)
      ! Diode1
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d1,1,0.0)
      ! Diode4
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d4,1,0.0)
      CALL Block_Finder_FullBridge($DimC,$FP1,$FP2,$FP3,$FP4,IVD1_1)
      IF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 1) THEN        ! If blocked
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I1,0,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I2,1,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I3,1,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I4,0,0.0)
      ELSEIF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 0) THEN
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I1,1,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I2,0,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I3,0,0.0)
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I4,1,0.0)
      ENDIF
      CALL FULLCELL2_EXE($R5,$DimC,$FP1,$FP2,$FP3,$FP4,IVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_4,RVD1_5,$Vc,$Ic)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRx, 0, RVD1_4, -RVD1_5)
      EBRD($BRx,$SS) = -RVD1_5
#ELSE
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_6
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_7
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_8
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_9
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_10
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_11
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_12
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_13
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_14
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_15
 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_2
 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_3
 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_4
      RVD1_1 = RTCF(NRTCF)
      NRTCF = NRTCF + 1
      RVD1_2  = CBR($BRx1,$SS)
      RVD1_3  = CBR($BRx2,$SS)
      RVD1_4  = CBR($BRx3,$SS)
      RVD1_5  = CBR($BRx4,$SS)
      CALL FULLCELL_PB2_EXE($R5,$DimC,$FP1,$FP2,$FP3,$FP4,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,
     +RVD1_3,RVD1_4,RVD1_5,RVD1_6,RVD1_7,RVD1_8,RVD1_9,RVD1_10,RVD1_11,
     +RVD1_12,RVD1_13,RVD1_14,RVD1_15,$Vc,$Ic,IVD1_1,IVD1_2,IVD1_3,IVD1_4)
      ! Diode1 to 8
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d1,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d2,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d3,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d4,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d5,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d6,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d7,1,0.0)
      CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_d8,1,0.0)
      IF (IVD1_4.EQ.1) THEN
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I1,0,0.0)
      ELSE
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BR_I1,1,0.0)
      ENDIF
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRx1, 0, RVD1_6, -RVD1_10)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRx2, 0, RVD1_7, -RVD1_11)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRx3, 0, RVD1_8, -RVD1_12)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRx4, 0, RVD1_9, -RVD1_13)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BR_Rv1, 0, RVD1_14, 0.0)
      CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BR_Rv2, 0, RVD1_15, 0.0)
      EBRD($BRx1,$SS) = -RVD1_10
      EBRD($BRx2,$SS) = -RVD1_11
      EBRD($BRx3,$SS) = -RVD1_12
      EBRD($BRx4,$SS) = -RVD1_13
#ENDIF

      CALL PESWITCH1_CFG(0, 0, RVD1_1, 100e6, 1.0e8, 1.0e8, 0.0, 0.0)
      ! IGBT

 #ENDIF

! Series diode

        CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRN, 0, RVD1_2, -RVD1_3)

        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BrTs,0,0.0)
! Parallel IGBT
        CALL PESWITCH1_EXE($SS,$BrTp,1,0.0)
      ELSEIF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 0) THEN
        CALL E_VARRLC1_EXE(0 ,$SS , $BRN, 0, RVD1_2, -RVD1_3)

! ThetaC
      #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
      #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1
#BEGIN
  #IF FLogic==0
      CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component)
      CALL E_XSGEN1_CFG(1,$Ps0,100,TWO_PI,0.0)
  #ENDIF
#ENDBEGIN
#IF FLogic==1
      !  if tracking frequency
      !  angle resolver   
  #IF PMode==1
      !  If Degrees
      RVD1_1 = $ThetaIn*BY180_PI
  #ELSE
      !  if Radians
      RVD1_1 = $ThetaIn
  #ENDIF

#ENDIF
#IF FLogic==0
 !  if fixed frequency (no tracking), then generate a saw thoot function
  #STORAGE REAL:6 LOGICAL:1 RTCF:4
#ENDIF
#IF FLogic==0
      #LOCAL REAL ThetaOut 2
      CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component)
      CALL E_XSGEN1_EXE(1,$F,ThetaOut)
      RVD1_1 = ThetaOut(1)
#ENDIF
#IF (Type==1||Type==2)
      #LOCAL REAL RVD1_3
      #LOCAL REAL RVD1_4   
      !  Phase disposition and alternative phase disposition
      RVD1_1 = RVD1_1 * $Cfreq
      !  Angle resolver 
      RVD1_1 = ATAN2(sin(RVD1_1),cos(RVD1_1))
      IF (RVD1_1.LE. 0.0) THEN
        RVD1_1 = RVD1_1 + TWO_PI
      ENDIF
      !  Per unitization of Theta
      RVD1_1 = RVD1_1*BY_PI
      IF(RVD1_1.GE.1.0) THEN
        RVD1_1 = 2.0 - RVD1_1
      ENDIF
!
      DO IVD1_1=1,$DimC
      #IF (Type==1)
          RVD1_4 = $Min + REAL(IVD1_1-1)*($Max-$Min)/REAL($DimC)
          RVD1_3 = RVD1_4 + ($Max-$Min)/REAL($DimC)
          $Carr(IVD1_1) = RVD1_1*(RVD1_3-RVD1_4) + RVD1_4
      #ELSEIF (Type==2)
          RVD1_4 = $Min + REAL(IVD1_1-1)*($Max-$Min)/REAL($DimC)
          RVD1_3 = RVD1_4 + ($Max-$Min)/REAL($DimC)
          IF(INT(INT(IVD1_1*0.5)*2).NE.IVD1_1) THEN
            ! if odd number
          $Carr(IVD1_1) = RVD1_1*(RVD1_3-RVD1_4) + RVD1_4
          ELSE
            ! if even number
            $Carr(IVD1_1) = RVD1_3 - RVD1_1*(RVD1_3-RVD1_4)
          ENDIF          
      #ENDIF
      END DO
#ELSEIF Type==3
      !  Phase shifting
      #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
      RVD1_1 = RVD1_1 * $Cfreq
      DO IVD1_1=1,$DimC
        RVD1_2 = RVD1_1 + TWO_PI/REAL($DimC)*REAL(IVD1_1-1)
        !  Angle resolver 
        RVD1_2 = ATAN2(sin(RVD1_2),cos(RVD1_2))
        IF (RVD1_2.LE. 0.0) THEN
          RVD1_2 = RVD1_2 + TWO_PI
        ENDIF
        !  Per unitization of Theta
        RVD1_2 = RVD1_2*BY_PI
        IF(RVD1_2.GE.1.0) THEN
          RVD1_2 = 2.0 - RVD1_2
        ENDIF
        RVD1_2 = RVD1_2*($Max-$Min) + $Min
        $Carr(IVD1_1) = RVD1_2
      END DO
#ENDIF

scripts.Computations:
REAL   w  = 2*pi*f
REAL   Bpp= len/Bp/1E6
REAL   Bzz= len/Bz/1E6
REAL   Cs = (Bzz+2*Bpp)/3/w
REAL   Cm = (Bzz-Bpp)/3/w
REAL   Rm = abs(Rz-Rp)*len/3 <= 1.0E-20 ? 0.0 : (Rz-Rp)*len/3
REAL   Lm = abs(Xz-Xp)*len/3/w <= 1.0E-20 ? 0.0 : (Xz-Xp)*len/3/w
REAL   R  = Rp*len
REAL   L  = Xp*len/w
REAL   C  = abs(Cm)*1.0e6/2 <= 1.0E-20 ? 0.0 : -Cm*1.0e6/2
REAL   Cg = (Cs+2*Cm)*1.0e6/2 <= 1.0E-20 ? 0.0 : (Cs+2*Cm)*1.0e6/2
scripts.Checks:
ERROR Rz must be larger than Rp : Rz>Rp
ERROR Xz must be larger than Xp : Xz>Xp
ERROR Bz must be larger than Bp : Bz>Bp

#STORAGE REAL:1 INTEGER:1 RTCF:2
#BEGIN
      RTCF(NRTCF)   = $Ton
      RTCF(NRTCF+1) = $Toff
      NRTCF = NRTCF + 2
#ENDBEGIN
#LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
#LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
      RVD1_1 = RTCF(NRTCF)
      RVD1_2 = RTCF(NRTCF+1)
      IF (TIMEZERO) THEN
#IF INITST==0
        IF ($in .EQ. 0) THEN
          IVD1_1 = 1
        ELSE
          IVD1_1 = 2
        ENDIF
#ELSEIF INITST==1
        IF ($in .EQ. 0) THEN
          IVD1_1 = 4
        ELSE
          IVD1_1 = 3
        ENDIF
#ELSE
        IF ($in .EQ. 0) THEN
          IVD1_1 = 1
        ELSE
          IVD1_1 = 3
        ENDIF
#ENDIF        
      ELSE
        IVD1_1 = STORI(NSTORI)
      ENDIF
      IF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 1) THEN
        IF ($in .NE. 0) THEN
           IF (RVD1_1 .LT. 0.5*DELT) THEN
             IVD1_1 = 3
             $out = 1
           ELSE
             STORF(NSTORF) = TIME
             IVD1_1 = 2
             $out = 0
           ENDIF
        ELSE
          $out = 0
          IVD1_1 = 1
        ENDIF
      ELSEIF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 2) THEN
        IF ($in .EQ. 0) THEN
          STORF(NSTORF) = 1.0E32
          IVD1_1 = 1
          $out = 0
        ELSEIF (TIME .GE. (STORF(NSTORF)+RVD1_1)) THEN
          STORF(NSTORF) = 1.0E32
          IVD1_1 = 3
          $out = 1
        ELSE
          IVD1_1 = 2
          $out = 0
        ENDIF
      ELSEIF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 3) THEN
        IF ($in .EQ. 0) THEN
           IF (RVD1_2 .LT. 0.5*DELT) THEN
             IVD1_1 = 1
             $out = 0
           ELSE
             STORF(NSTORF) = TIME
             IVD1_1 = 4
             $out = 1
           ENDIF
        ELSE
          $out = 1
          IVD1_1 = 3
        ENDIF
      ELSEIF (IVD1_1 .EQ. 4) THEN
        IF ($in .EQ. 1) THEN
          STORF(NSTORF) = 1.0E32
          IVD1_1 = 3
          $out = 1
        ELSEIF (TIME .GE. (STORF(NSTORF)+RVD1_2)) THEN
          STORF(NSTORF) = 1.0E32
          IVD1_1 = 1
          $out = 0
        ELSE
          IVD1_1 = 4
          $out = 1
        ENDIF
      ENDIF
      STORI(NSTORI) = IVD1_1
      NSTORI = NSTORI + 1
      NSTORF = NSTORF + 1
      NRTCF  = NRTCF  + 2

any customer changes to this file should be emailed to: lha@hvdc.ca
Recorder1_2 and Recorder2_0 extend the comtrade output capability to
       the v1.2 Playback systems while maintaining identical FORTRAN code
implementation. The original Recorder icon did not support comtrade 
output files.
  
differences between v1.2 and v2.0 playback h/w & s/w capabilities:

                   v1.2        v2.0
analog channels     10          12
analog resolution   12 bits     16 bits
digital channels     0          16

differences between Recorder1_2 and Recorder2_0 files:

Recorder1_2
    limited to 10 analog channels 
    digital channel capacity disabled, defaults to 0 channels
    "v1.2 Recorder"
    "Number of 12-bit Analog Channels"
    no "Digital Channels" text
Recorder2_0
    limited to 12 analog channels 
    digital channel capacity enabled, defaults to 0 channels
    "v2.0 Recorder"
    "Number of 16-bit Analog Channels"
Other Changes
    these routines (which were called EVERY timestep):
    call rtps_a_var_name, call rtps_d_var_name, 
    call rtps_a_var_des,  call rtps_d_var_des, 
    call rtps_hdr
    are replaced by PassVars(...) which is called only once
    ABFMT, Comtrade 96
    FName limited to 20 chars (F90 did not like ~' continuation)
    Dec. 16/96 - removed norotate, nomirror 
    Dec. 17/96 - changed all instances of RTPS to RTP
        Dec. 18/96 - "units" dialog box listed only if any "other" vars
           - "pt/ct" dialog box listed only if any "primary" vars
           - changed some dialog titles
    Jan. 08/97 - reduced size of DA,DD: 40 -> 25
         SaveAn and SaveDig
    Feb. 03/97 - Comtrade 91 std also allows multiple output files

#STORAGE REAL:1
! Sequencer - Wait for Signal to Cross $CrossValue
#IF ( CrossDir == 1 )
!             from -ve to +ve.
#ELSEIF ( CrossDir == -1 )
!             from +ve to -ve.
#ELSE
!             in any direction.
#ENDIF
      $OState = 0
      IF ( $IState .NE. 0 ) THEN
         IF (STORI(NSTORI) .EQ. 0) THEN
#IF ( CrossDir == 1 )
            IF ( ($CrossSig.GE.$CrossValue).AND.(STORF(NSTORF).LT.$CrossValue) ) THEN
#ELSEIF ( CrossDir == -1 )
            IF ( ($CrossSig.LE.$CrossValue).AND.(STORF(NSTORF).GT.$CrossValue) ) THEN
#ELSE
            IF ( (($CrossSig.GE.$CrossValue).AND.(STORF(NSTORF).LT.$CrossValue)).OR.(($CrossSig.LE.$CrossValue).AND.(STORF(NSTORF).GT.$CrossValue)) ) THEN
#ENDIF
               $OState = 1
            ENDIF
         ELSE
            $OState = 1
         ENDIF
      ENDIF
      STORF(NSTORF)=$CrossSig
      NSTORF = NSTORF + 1
#ENDIF
#STORAGE INTEGER:1
! Update PSCAD Graphics
      IF ( FIRSTSTEP ) THEN
         CALL PSCAD_AGI2(ICALL_NO,$#Component,0,"State")
      ENDIF
      IF ( STORI(NSTORI) .NE. $OState ) THEN
         CALL PSCAD_AGI2(ICALL_NO,$#Component,$OState,"State")
         STORI(NSTORI) = $OState
      ENDIF
      NSTORI = NSTORI + 1

        $Vout = -1

#BEGIN
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_3
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_4
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_5
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_6
 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1
      RVD1_1 = ONE_3RD*$Tmva
      RVD1_2 = SQRT_1BY3*$Vhigh
      RVD1_3 = SQRT_1BY3*$Vlow
      CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component)
      CALL E_TF2WA_CFG($#[1],$Ideal,RVD1_1,$f,$Xlauto,$CuL,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
      CALL E_TF2WA_CFG($#[2],$Ideal,RVD1_1,$f,$Xlauto,$CuL,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
      CALL E_TF2WA_CFG($#[3],$Ideal,RVD1_1,$f,$Xlauto,$CuL,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
      IF ($NLL .LT. 1.0E-6) THEN
        RVD1_4 = 0.0
        IVD1_1 = 0
      ELSE
        RVD1_6 = $NLL
        RVD1_4 = 1.0/(RVD1_1*RVD1_6)
        IVD1_1 = 1
      ENDIF

 #ENDIF

      CALL E_TF3WA_CFG($#[3],$Ideal,RVD1_4,$f,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT,0.0,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)

scripts.Dsdyn:
#BEGIN
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_3
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_4   
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_5   
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_6   
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_7   
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_8   
 #LOCAL INTEGER IVD1_1   
      CALL COMPONENT_ID(ICALL_NO,$#Component)
      RVD1_1 = SQRT_1BY3*$VH
      RVD1_2 = SQRT_1BY3*$VL
 #IF DS==0
      RVD1_3 = SQRT_1BY3*$VT
 #ELSE
      RVD1_3 = $VT
 #ENDIF
      RVD1_4 = ONE_3RD*$Tmva
      CALL E_TF3WA_CFG($#[1],$Ideal,RVD1_4,$f,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT,0.0,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
      CALL E_TF3WA_CFG($#[2],$Ideal,RVD1_4,$f,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT,0.0,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
      CALL E_TF3WA_CFG($#[3],$Ideal,RVD1_4,$f,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT,0.0,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1)
 #IF Enab==1
  #IF Sat==1
      RTCF(NRTCF)   = RVD1_1/RVD1_4
      RTCF(NRTCF+1) = TWO_PI*$f/RVD1_1
  #ELSE
      RTCF(NRTCF)   = RVD1_3/RVD1_4
      RTCF(NRTCF+1) = TWO_PI*$f/RVD1_3
  #ENDIF
      NRTCF = NRTCF + 2
      CALL TSAT1_CFG($BRS1,$BRS2,$BRS3,$SS,RVD1_4,
  #IF Sat==1
     + RVD1_1,
  #ELSE
     + RVD1_3,
  #ENDIF
     + $Xair,$Xknee,$f,0.0,$Im1,0.0)
 #ENDIF
      IF ($NLL .LT. 1.0E-6) THEN
        IVD1_1 = 0
        RVD1_5 = 0.0
        RVD1_6 = 0.0
        RVD1_7 = 0.0
      ELSE
        IVD1_1 = 1
        RVD1_7 = $NLL
        RVD1_8 = 2.0/(RVD1_4*RVD1_7)
        RVD1_5 = RVD1_8*RVD1_1*RVD1_1
        RVD1_6 = RVD1_8*RVD1_3*RVD1_3
      ENDIF
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRHL(1),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_5,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRHL(2),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_5,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRHL(3),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_5,0.0,0.0)
  #IF DS==0
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT(1),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT(2),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT(3),$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
  #ELSE
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT1,$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT2,$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
      CALL E_BRANCH_CFG($BRT3,$SS,IVD1_1,0,0,RVD1_6,0.0,0.0)
  #ENDIF
 #IF Tap==1
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_CFG($#[1],RVD1_4,$f,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT)
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_CFG($#[2],RVD1_4,$f,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT)
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_CFG($#[3],RVD1_4,$f,RVD1_1,RVD1_2,RVD1_3,$Im1,$XlHL,$XlHT,$XlLT)
 #ENDIF
#ENDBEGIN
#IF Enab==1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_1
 #LOCAL REAL RVD1_2
      RVD1_1 = RTCF(NRTCF)
      RVD1_2 = RTCF(NRTCF+1)
      NRTCF = NRTCF + 2
!  TRANSFORMER SATURATION SUBROUTINE
 #STORAGE STOR:21 RTCF:17
      CALL TSAT1_EXE($BRS1,$BRS2,$BRS3,$SS,1.0,$Enab)
 #OUTPUT REAL IMAG 3 {-STOR(NEXC-21+17)*RVD1_1} {-STOR(NEXC-21+18)*RVD1_1} {-STOR(NEXC-21+19)*RVD1_1}
 #OUTPUT REAL FLUX 3 {STOR(NEXC-21+11)*RVD1_2} {STOR(NEXC-21+13)*RVD1_2} {STOR(NEXC-21+15)*RVD1_2}
#ENDIF
#IF Tap==1
 #STORAGE RTCF:33
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_EXE($#[1],2,3,1,$TapI)
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_EXE($#[2],2,3,1,$TapI)
      CALL TRTAP3WA1_EXE($#[3],2,3,1,$TapI)
#ENDIF
